faqs.question: Are the quiz results checked against live stock?
faqs.answer: No — matches come from the care tags on this page, not a stock system. The bench changes weekly, so email us with the plant name and we'll confirm what's actually here and put one aside.

faqs.question: What does the pet-safe tag mean?
faqs.answer: Pet-safe plants are ones widely listed as non-toxic to cats and dogs. A nibble shouldn't cause harm — but no plant enjoys being a salad, so still keep leaves out of reach of committed grazers.

faqs.question: Can you hold a plant for me?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send the reserve email from any plant card and we'll keep one on the bench with your name on it for three days. No deposit — if you change your mind, just tell us.

faqs.question: Every plant I've owned has died. Is it hopeless?
faqs.answer: It's almost always too much water or too little light, not a curse. Answer the quiz honestly — especially the watering question — and start with whatever it suggests. Our unofficial record is four snake plants thriving in one very dark flat.

faqs.question: Do you deliver?
faqs.answer: Within Bristol, yes — we do a cargo-bike round on Fridays. Mention delivery in your email and we'll confirm a slot. Further afield, plants travel badly and we'd rather be honest about that.
